text:
Which statement about Group I or Group VII elements is correct?
A
Group VII elements are monatomic non-metals.
B
Lithium is more reactive with water than caesium.
C
The melting point of Group I metals increases down the group.
D
Potassium bromide reacts with chlorine to produce an orange solution.

options.label: A
options.text: Group VII elements are monatomic non-metals.

options.label: B
options.text: Lithium is more reactive with water than caesium.

options.label: C
options.text: The melting point of Group I metals increases down the group.

options.label: D
options.text: Potassium bromide reacts with chlorine to produce an orange solution.
